name: Save a guest quotation with a durable reference
description: A visitor can submit equipment requirements and receives a persisted reference.
steps: Open Home and choose Get a quote.
Enter name QA Equipment Buyer, contact qa-buyer@example.com, quantity 2 and message Two office laptops.
Agree to be contacted and send the request.
Confirm a TS- reference is shown. Close the dialog and navigate to Services, About and Contact.
expected: The request is saved and a reference is displayed only after the server accepts it; all public pages are usable.

name: Manage product lifecycle and public browsing
description: The approved administrator can manage a product and visitors only see published products.
steps: Open Admin and sign in using the approved project-owner account. If that account is unavailable, report this test as blocked rather than bypassing authorization.
Add a product named QA Office Laptop with category Laptops, description QA test equipment, price 850000 and availability Available. Upload a real small PNG image. Save as Draft.
Confirm the product persists after refreshing Admin and is absent from the public catalog.
Edit it to Published, save, and open Products. Search QA Office Laptop, filter Laptops, and open the product detail.
Submit a product request with name QA Product Buyer, contact qa-product@example.com, quantity 1 and consent. Confirm a TS- reference.
Return to Admin, replace the image by uploading another PNG and removing the first from the product. Save and refresh to verify the new image persists.
Archive the product and verify it disappears from the public catalog. Restore it to Published and verify it returns.
expected: Product and image changes persist, publication states are enforced, search and details work, and the product request is saved.

name: Handle requests company content and audit history
description: An authorized owner can process incoming requests and update company information with audit history.
setup: Submit a Networking service request as QA Network Buyer with contact qa-network@example.com and message Assess our office network, with consent.
Submit a Contact request as QA Contact Buyer with contact qa-contact@example.com and message Please explain available computer services, with consent.
steps: Sign in to Admin with the approved owner account. If unavailable, report blocked.
Open Requests and find QA Network Buyer. Open its reference and update New to Contacted with reason QA reviewed.
Refresh the dashboard and confirm Contacted and its history remain visible. Continue to Confirmed and then Completed with reasons. Confirm no further status actions are offered.
Inspect the company email notification; retry if not Sent. If credentials are absent it must say Not configured without removing the request.
Open Company and save an updated about paragraph identifying TECHSAVY computer sales and IT services, without inventing contact details. Refresh and check About displays it.
Open Audit and verify product/request/content events appear when those operations have occurred. Sign out and confirm dashboard records disappear.
expected: Requests and content persist, terminal states cannot be changed, email failures remain visible and sign-out hides private data.

name: Mobile privacy motion and form guardrails
description: Mobile visitors can navigate and control motion while invalid submissions and unauthorized admin access are rejected.
steps: Open the mobile navigation and visit Services. Pause background animations with the header control. Navigate to About and confirm the preference remains.
Open Privacy preferences in the footer, allow analytics, and navigate Home then Products.
Request a service and try sending with missing name/contact, no consent and then an invalid contact value.
Verify a validation message and no successful request reference.
Open Admin while signed out and confirm no products, request contacts or dashboard data are displayed.
expected: Navigation fits mobile, motion can be paused, analytics requires consent, invalid requests fail and private data is not exposed.

name: A backend failure never becomes a false success
description: A failed request save displays an error and keeps the form available.
steps: Open Get a quote and enter name QA Failure Buyer, contact qa-failure@example.com, quantity 1 and message A computer for design work.
Agree to be contacted and submit.
expected: A visible error appears, no success reference is shown and the form remains available for retry.
